stops.name: Brocken peak
stops.quote: Height varies from approximately 240 m in the north and 270 m on the southern edge up to 1,141 m on Brocken peak.
stops.english: Height varies from approximately 240 m in the north and 270 m on the southern edge up to 1,141 m on Brocken peak.

stops.name: Brocken
stops.quote: View to the Brocken - the highest mountain in the Harz (Photo: Mirko Lehmann)
stops.english: View to the Brocken - the highest mountain in the Harz (Photo: Mirko Lehmann)

stops.name: National Park Visitor Centres
stops.quote: A group of 39 rangers and several National Park Visitor Centres contribute a great deal to the services for the visitors.
stops.english: A group of 39 rangers and several National Park Visitor Centres contribute a great deal to the services for the visitors.

stops.name: rocky biotopes
stops.quote: Scientific research has identified numerous habitats which are, based on Middle-European standards, quite close to a natural state, such as the high and middle regions or zones of the Harz, rocky biotopes, many running waters, and a large beech, spruce and mixed forest area.
stops.english: Scientific research has identified numerous habitats which are, based on Middle-European standards, quite close to a natural state, such as the high and middle regions or zones of the Harz, rocky biotopes, many running waters, and a large beech, spruce and mixed forest area.
